operations.summary: What the server did with a cache write sent with this Idempotency-Key
operations.description: For a write whose response was lost (network, timeout, 5xx): accepted with the operation (the new one of a create or re-submit), or rejected with the error code the write was refused with. 404 means the server has no record of the key for the authenticated actor: the write was not received and may be sent again with the same key and body. Another actor's key is the same 404 (existence is never disclosed). Not-found and permission refusals of the write itself are not kept and also read as 404. Writes nothing.

params.name: idempotency_key
params.description: The Idempotency-Key the write was sent with (the batch key of a re-submit).

params.name: operation_id
params.description: The operation a retry, cancel or re-submit acts on; required for those, absent for create.

fields.name: rejection
fields.description: Present when rejected; code is the error code the write was answered with.
